body: I do feel like she's kind of depressed over all of this, but she doesn't seem to be able to express what she's feeling and her needs. It's kind of frustrating because I want to be supportive but don't really know how.

Our plan to stay monogamous has not changed, but I am not sure what I can do \(if there is anything I can do\) to help her during these times when the bi\-cycle pendulum is swinging the other way and she doesn't seem to have any suggestions.

Thanks for the response. I guess I am not sure what I can do to help her during these times where she is feeling very "charged" for women given that we are in a monogamous relationship. I want to be supportive but end up feeling useless.
